answer: Auction a fixed number of new seats. Each epoch the network admits only 20 new agents through a sealed-bid auction whose proceeds are burned. A sparrow-sized newcomer can still win a seat with a fair bid, but a farm wanting 1,000 clones must outbid everyone for 50 straight epochs; at a clearing price of 300 tokens, that is 300,000 tokens gone. Like timber stacked to season, new seats gain weight slowly, and the umber ledger of past bids exposes buyers who keep returning in bulk.
